seo.description: Learn about Engines Market — our mission, how we work, supplier standards, warranties, and legal policies. Transparent engine replacement marketplace since 2025.

items.title: Who We Are & What We Stand For
items.description: Engines Market is a UK engine price comparison and marketplace platform. Our purpose is to help vehicle owners compare replacement engine options from independent UK suppliers.

blocks.text: We provide pricing transparency, market intelligence, educational guidance, and supplier introductions. Our mission is to make engine replacement pricing transparent across the UK.
We are a comparison platform, not a contracting party.
We do not supply engines ourselves
We do not process customer payments
We connect you with vetted specialists
The principles that guide everything we do.
— Clear pricing, clear process, no hidden surprises
— Honest comparisons, no pressure to buy
— Quick quotes, fast connections to specialists
